description: Fill the gower-1975-published-history conformance fixture from Table 2 of Gower 1975 (coordinates in Table 1). Until then the fixture only records the citation and identities.
close_reason: Transcribed Gower 1975 Table 2 scores and Table 5 Sr path; gpa() is not required to match the 1975 schedule.

value: M4: Huber/Tukey IRLS is landmark-vector; cell/anisotropic MM is first_order_stationary never SVD. Model covariance is unused by gpa(). Goodall diagonal entity factor becomes landmark weights and leaves GPM. M5: bootstrap replicates must be polar-aligned to the original consensus before any coordinatewise SE. Analytic SEs are a declared tangent-chart approximation, not a certificate.

Use eigencore for every SVD/eigen in gprocrustes. LBW claim is exact_closed_form only for the constrained reference-space formulation with explicit Lambda; never call it globally optimal deformable GPA. Affine det<0 is orientation, not TPS folding.
